searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Keywords to search pins for, e.g. kitchen remodel, fall outfits, wedding cake.

startUrls.title: Pinterest URLs
startUrls.description: Pin URLs (pinterest.com/pin/...), board URLs (pinterest.com/user/board/), profile URLs (pinterest.com/user/, its created pins plus a profile row) or search URLs.

maxPinsPerSource.title: Max pins per query or URL
maxPinsPerSource.description: Stop each search, board or profile after this many pins.

maxPins.title: Max pins in total
maxPins.description: Stop the run after this many pins.

includeEngagement.title: Saves, repins and shares
includeEngagement.description: On: one extra call per pin for its save, repin, share and comment counts. Off: no engagement counts, half the price.

onlyNew.title: Only pins not returned before
onlyNew.description: On: each run returns only pins earlier runs with the same sources have not. For monitoring a search, board or profile on a schedule.
